def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    sep_rows = [i for i, row in enumerate(grid) if len(set(row)) == 1]
    sep_cols = [j for j in range(w) if len({grid[i][j] for i in range(h)}) == 1]
    row_bounds = [-1] + sep_rows + [h]
    col_bounds = [-1] + sep_cols + [w]
    regions = []
    for a,b in zip(row_bounds, row_bounds[1:]):
        if b-a <= 1: continue
        for c,d in zip(col_bounds, col_bounds[1:]):
            if d-c <= 1: continue
            vals = [grid[i][j] for i in range(a+1,b) for j in range(c+1,d)]
            regions.extend(vals)
    from collections import Counter
    bg = Counter(regions).most_common(1)[0][0]
    out=[]
    for a,b in zip(row_bounds, row_bounds[1:]):
        if b-a <= 1: continue
        line=[]
        for c,d in zip(col_bounds, col_bounds[1:]):
            if d-c <= 1: continue
            n=sum(grid[i][j] != bg for i in range(a+1,b) for j in range(c+1,d))
            line.append(1 if n==2 else 5)
        out.append(line)
    return out

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    sep_rows = [i for i, row in enumerate(grid) if len(set(row)) == 1]
    sep_cols = [j for j in range(w) if len({grid[i][j] for i in range(h)}) == 1]
    rb = [-1] + sep_rows + [h]
    cb = [-1] + sep_cols + [w]
    out = []
    from collections import Counter
    for a, b in zip(rb, rb[1:]):
        if b-a <= 1: continue
        row_out = []
        for c, d in zip(cb, cb[1:]):
            if d-c <= 1: continue
            cells = [grid[i][j] for i in range(a+1,b) for j in range(c+1,d)]
            counts = Counter(cells)
            bg, bg_count = counts.most_common(1)[0]
            marked = len(cells) - bg_count
            row_out.append(1 if marked == 2 else bg)
        out.append(row_out)
    return out
